faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Check the questions below to clarify your doubts.

question1.question: How can I hire your services?
question1.answer: Schedule your consultation with us via WhatsApp, and we will discuss your needs and assess the costs.

question2.question: What is the average timeframe for resolving a case?
question2.answer: The average timeframe varies depending on complexity, but we will provide an estimate during the initial consultation.

question3.question: Which documents should I bring to the consultation?
question3.answer: Bring documents relevant to your case, such as contracts, correspondence, and records, as well as personal documents and proof of residence.

question4.question: Do you offer preventive consulting services?
question4.answer: Yes, we offer preventive consulting to avoid future problems and ensure legal compliance.
